reason: This plugin is primarily a media-generation utility for DSH: it scans provided script and multimedia assets, builds a playable visual-novel HTML experience, and wires it into the DSH web interface for playback. Core capabilities include branching/script parsing, save states, sprite/background/BGM control, and standalone output generation. No external-service/network control is evident; risk is moderate due generated local HTML/media handling in the browser context (R1).

capabilities: Parse document-based script and workspace assets to generate a playable HTML visual-novel output.
Expose DSH tools for scanning workspace inputs and building generated output.
Integrate a web UI entrypoint (sidebar button/preset) for launching the generated game.
